name: What should I do to prepare my bathroom before a plumber arrives for a toilet replacement?

mainEntity.name: What should I do to prepare my bathroom before a plumber arrives for a toilet replacement?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before your plumber arrives for a toilet replacement, please ensure the area around the toilet is clear of any bath mats, decorative items, or personal belongings. It's also helpful if the floor around the toilet is reasonably clean. This preparation allows our technicians to work efficiently and safely without needing to move your items, which streamlines the process for both parties.
acceptedAnswer.description: Clear the area around the toilet of all belongings and ensure the floor is clean. This helps our plumbers work efficiently and safely.
